items.headline: NFL's success in Africa has changed scouting process, says Osi Umenyiora
items.description: Former NFL star and current coach Osi Umenyiora told ESPN that while in the past, he and his networks had to scout relentlessly for talent in Africa, the success of its recent homegrown stars has led prospects to approach scouts directly.
